title: MA-UITD: Offline Multi-Agent Reward Inference for Characterizing Continuous Social Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2610.29237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making. Inferring rewards from interacting agents is challenging because observed choices reflect both personal preferences and expectations about others. Existing methods often require additional environment interaction, repeated policy optimization as an inner loop, or restrictive assumptions about environment dynamics and action spaces, limiting their applicability to fixed behavioral datasets. We introduce Multi-Agent Unilateral Inverse Temporal Difference Learning (MA-UITD), an offline method for inferring explicit agent-specific rewards from joint demonstrations in continuous-state environments with either discrete or bounded continuous actions. translated_title: MA-UITD：用于刻画连续社会行为的离线多智能体奖励推断
translated_abstract: 多智能体逆强化学习不仅为模仿学习提供了一个强大的框架，也为理解支持社会互动和决策的神经计算提供了有力工具。从相互作用的智能体中推断奖励具有挑战性，因为观察到的选择既反映个人偏好，也反映对他人的预期。现有方法通常需要额外的环境交互、以内循环形式进行的重复策略优化，或对环境动力学和动作空间的严格假设，这限制了它们在固定行为数据集上的适用性。我们提出了多智能体单边逆时序差分学习（MA-UITD），这是一种离线方法，可从连续状态环境（动作空间为离散或有界连续）的联合演示中推断出显式的智能体特定奖励。其核心思想是通过表征每个智能体自身动作的长期后果……
tldr: 提出MA-UITD，一种离线多智能体奖励推断方法，无需额外环境交互即可从固定行为数据集的联合演示中推断显式的智能体特定奖励，用于刻画连续社会行为。
en_tdlr: MA-UITD is an offline multi-agent reward inference method that extracts explicit agent-specific rewards from joint demonstrations in fixed behavioral datasets, enabling characterization of continuous social behavior without additional environment interaction.
